title: Fix naive and aware datetimes colliding across two modules
prompt: Scheduled jobs occasionally crash with "can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes", and overnight maintenance windows are evaluated incorrectly for users outside UTC. src/scheduling.py parses window definitions and src/jobs.py decides whether a job may run now. One module produces naive datetimes and the other produces aware ones. Make the whole datetime path timezone-aware in UTC: parse_window must return aware UTC datetimes, is_within_window must accept aware datetimes and reject naive ones with ValueError, and a window that crosses midnight must be handled correctly. Do not change any public function signature.
acceptance_criteria: is_within_window accepts aware datetimes in any timezone and compares correctly.
A naive datetime passed to is_within_window raises ValueError rather than crashing on comparison.
A window crossing midnight (for example 22:00-04:00) is evaluated correctly on both sides.
next_run_after returns an aware UTC datetime.
